### 1. Versioning Proposal Review

**Proposal Document**: [Execution APIs v1.0.0 - Versioning Proposal](https://hackmd.io/@bomanaps/rJiHuPFOZl),  [ethereum-magicians](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/repo-endpoint-level-versioning-for-the-json-rpc-api-seeking-community/27765?u=bomanaps)
